Free online Markdown editor and viewer

Rapier is a free online Markdown editor and viewer. Open a .md file to read it formatted. Write on the formatted page or in the Markdown source; there is no split preview. The file stays plain Markdown. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0-only); no account, ads or tracking; works offline.

Free online Markdown editor

Headings, lists, checklists, tables, footnotes, callouts, syntax-colored code, LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams, with find and replace, text-to-speech and undo. Paste cells from a spreadsheet and they become a Markdown table. PNG, JPEG, WebP, JPEG XL and SVG pictures live inside the Markdown file, and text wraps around their real shape. Rapier keeps a draft as you work, and Save writes a .md file.

Free online Markdown viewer

Tap ••• at the top right, then open, and pick a .md file; on Android, open it from your file manager. Headings, tables, checklists, code, math and Mermaid diagrams show formatted. Nothing is uploaded; it works offline. Edit in place, switch to the source, or turn on read only in settings.

Markdown to PDF

Paste or open your Markdown, tap ••• at the top right, then .pdf under export. The PDF is written on your device, nothing uploaded: searchable text, tables, code, math and pictures as they look on the page. The Markdown travels inside the PDF, so Rapier opens it again as the same file. Markdown to PDF

Markdown to Word

Tap ••• at the top right, then .docx under export, for an editable Word document with headings, lists, tables, code and pictures. Markdown to Word

Word to Markdown

Tap ••• at the top right, then open, and pick a .docx file. It becomes an editable Markdown page, pictures included, and Save writes the .md file. Word to Markdown

PDF to Markdown

Tap ••• at the top right, then open, and pick a .pdf file. Choose Editable text and it becomes Markdown you can edit, pictures included. PDF to Markdown

Compare Markdown files

Open the older file, then tap ••• and compare, and pick the newer one. A moved paragraph shows as a move. Compare Markdown files

Mermaid diagram editor

Write a mermaid code block and the diagram is drawn on the page. Flowcharts draw at once; sequence diagrams, Gantt charts and the rest use the free diagram plug-in, which downloads once. Mermaid diagram editor

Other files

Rapier also opens text, code, TextPack and PDF (PDF import is a free plug-in), and exports plain text and a static offline web page. Share a .rapier.html file with the whole editor inside so someone can edit or comment offline and send it back.

Notes, drawing and painting

Notes are Markdown files with colors, pins, checklists, voice recordings, tags, history and search; import from Google Keep, Evernote, Notion, Obsidian and 15+ other apps. Draw freehand or build diagrams with connected arrows, kept as editable SVG inside your file. Paint with oil, pencil, marker and MyPaint brushes, or watercolor with flowing pigments on textured paper. The Gallery holds thousands of free ornaments, borders and decorative letters, and the JPEG XL converter makes JXL pictures on your device.

AI agents

An AI agent can edit with you live, and you see its changes and undo any of them. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Cursor or another MCP client to https://mcp.rapier.website/door/mcp with no account, or use WebMCP in the browser. See the agent guide.

Where it runs

In a browser, on Android (Google Play), Windows and Linux, or as one HTML file that you keep in a folder. The Android app has no internet permission.
